Can you play an effective management if there are no vampires left in your

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Deviant One wrote:
>
> Can you play an effective management if there are no vampires left in your
> crypt?

No. Effective Management is effectively choosing/targetting the top vampire
on your crypt and:

Playing Cards

* If a card targets (chooses, selects, is played on, etc.) another card,
then the card can only be played if an appropriate target is available.
Examples: Strike: Steal/Destroy Equipment/Weapon cannot be used if the
opposing minion doesn't have a suitable Equipment/Weapon to be
destroyed/stolen. [RTR 19980928]

(Note the different ruling for Illusions of Kindred, which doesn't target
your crypt exactly - similar to the effect of a Vast Wealth action or a
Magic of the Smith action when there is no more equipment in your library.
That ruling may be out of date (superceded by the "Playing Cards" ruling
above), but it hasn't really come up that often, so hasn't been revisited
by the RT. I'll put it on the list).

> Are conservative agitations cumulative in their effect?

?
Yes. Each one resolves independently, with their independent results.
If a Methuselah has to lose 3 to one CA and 2 to the next, she'll burn
five pool (assuming both referendums pass and are not cancelled, etc.)
